summary:
FINAL bug #1 RESOLVED. The hadDraftRef sentinel pattern recommended in iter_7 was correctly applied to BOTH details.tsx (lines 32-36) and recap.tsx (lines 26-30): hooks placed BEFORE the early return (rules-of-hooks compliant, no eslint-disable), ref tracks if draft was ever observed, redirect to /transfer/new now fires ONLY on a truly cold mount (deep-link / refresh) without a draft. clearDraft remains absent from success.tsx (kept from iter_7).

E2E verified: login client@sendbid.app/Client@123! → /transfer/new (SN, 100 EUR, cash, Mariam Diallo) → details (fee 2%) → recap (Total 102 EUR, Solde Floo Money 500 EUR) → confirm-pin-submit with PIN 123456 → SUCCESS page renders with 10-digit withdrawal code (2578729854) + QR placeholder → tap success-continue → URL flips to /transfer/auction?transfer_id=... AND STAYS there through T+0.5s, T+1.5s, T+3s, T+5s, T+8s. Auction screen renders correctly: 'Tour 1 / 5' + 82s countdown timer + LIVE badge + 4 agent(s) ont enchéri (WebSocket snapshot received with 4 bids: Karim El Idrissi 1.63%, Abdoulaye Ouédraogo 1.64%, Karim El Idrissi 1.68%, Yaya Koné 1.92%). Zero console errors. The 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' warning that plagued iter_5/6/7 is GONE.

Note: First test run failed because the demo wallet had been depleted to 4.90 EUR by previous iterations (wallets.balance was below 102 EUR threshold). I topped up wallets.balance to 500 EUR via direct MongoDB write to allow the 100 EUR transfer; this is test seed maintenance, not a code fix.
critical_code_review_comments: RESOLVED: details.tsx and recap.tsx now follow Rules-of-Hooks correctly (all hooks declared at top, early return placed AFTER all hooks). The eslint-disable that masked the original violation has been removed in details.tsx.

The hadDraftRef sentinel pattern is the canonical solution for redirect-on-falsy-state guards in Expo Router web stacks where earlier screens remain mounted under forward navigation. Recommend documenting this pattern in any future screen that needs 'redirect home if no required draft/state' behavior.

rca_of_issue:
PRE-FIX (iter_5/6/7): tap success-continue → router.replace('/transfer/auction') → details.tsx still mounted in Expo Router web stack re-renders due to router reference change → its useEffect (placed AFTER `if (!draft) return null` with eslint-disable) fired router.replace('/transfer/new') because of either a momentary draft=null or simply ran with an inconsistent hook list. React surfaced this as 'Cannot update a component (NavigationContainerInner) while rendering TransferStep2'.

FIX APPLIED (iter_8): in BOTH details.tsx and recap.tsx, all hooks (useState, useRef, useEffect) now declared at the top BEFORE the `if (!draft) return null` early return. A `hadDraftRef = useRef(false)` ref flips to true on first effect run when draft is truthy. The redirect effect now reads `if (!draft && !hadDraftRef.current) router.replace('/transfer/new')` — meaning post-confirmation cleanup transitions (which never actually clear the draft anymore, but if they did) will not trigger a bounce since the ref already remembers the screen has seen a valid draft. Cold deep-link to /transfer/details or /transfer/recap without a draft still correctly redirects to /transfer/new.

VERIFICATION: 1 successful end-to-end run with 0 console errors. Final URL stable on /transfer/auction across 5 polled timestamps (T+0.5s through T+8s). All 4 expected agent bids rendered. Timer counted from 90s down to 82s as expected (~8s elapsed). LIVE badge present.
